title: Composition of normalized regular scalar units
statement: Let $A,B,C$ be finite commutative rings in the coefficient universe, let $\phi:A\to B$, $\psi:B\to C$, and $\chi:A\to C$ be unital ring maps with $h:\chi=\psi\phi$, and let $S$ be any scheme. Write $T_\phi,T_\psi,T_\chi$ for the derived small-etale scalar-extension functors and $a:T_\phi T_\psi\cong T_\chi$ for the left-adjoint conjugate of restriction composition [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]. For the regular-unit identifications $e_\theta:T_\theta(\mathbf1)\cong\mathbf1$ normalized by multiplication on cochain representatives [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations], one has $T_\psi(e_\phi);e_\psi=a_{\mathbf1};e_\chi$. No compact-support, exceptional or dualizing functor occurs.

source.place: The sentence "Their quotient compatibility makes them a map of normalized derived towers": the regular-unit composition subcalculation before exceptional transposition.

proof.text: Express each normalized derived unit as the scalar-adjunction transpose of the ordinary regular coefficient insertion. Expand its representative normalization and the scalar cochain transpose; the two localization unit comparisons cancel. Uniqueness in the normalization identifies the resulting map with the published unitIso.

The ordinary regular coefficient insertions compose: after constant sheafification both maps send a to psi(phi(a)), and the constant-sheaf adjunction detects equality on the regular generator. This includes zero rings and identity coefficient maps.

Apply scalarAdjointInsertion_comp to the preceding insertion equation. Its associator is by definition the fixed pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp. Substitute the normalized maps from the first step and transport along chi=psi.comp(phi).

theorem finiteCoefficient_unit_composition
    {A B C : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Finite A] [Finite B] [Finite C]
    (φ : A →+* B) (ψ : B →+* C) (χ : A →+* C) (hχ : χ = ψ.comp φ)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    (Etale.scalarExtension ψ S).map (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ S).hom ≫
        (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso ψ S).hom =
      (ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp S.smallEtaleTopology φ ψ χ hχ).hom.app
          (𝟙_ (Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A S)) ≫
        (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso χ S).hom
